doc.title: Joe LaBarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 15, 2021

title: Losing the Mickey Mouse Club audition to Steve Gadd
summary: The family band and Steve Gadd auditioned; Gadd won and Joe had to take tap lessons.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Um hum. I’ve picked up, our viewers should know that I have also met with your two brothers so a few little anecdotes: I understand that the band and Steve Gadd auditioned for the Mickey Mouse Club.
And he beat you all, is that correct?
He did. That is correct. Hey listen, if you’re going to lose to somebody it might as well be somebody great you know.
Is it true that you had to start taking tap dance lessons after that? Because Steve tap danced?
